description_summary: Triage review findings interactively — approve, skip, or prioritize each issue. Use after /ts:review to filter findings before fixing.
should_trigger: Prioritize the findings from the completed review before applying fixes.
Walk through which review issues to fix, skip or defer.
Create a fix queue from the selected review findings.
Group review findings by severity for a decision.
Triage this review report and retain the rejected recommendations.
should_trigger_test: Separate deferred work from the current approved correction scope.
Show evidence for each finding before recording its triage decision.
should_not_trigger: Review this branch diff for correctness and starter architecture issues.
Fix this typo in one mobile component with a contained edit.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
